summary: Ran end-to-end tests of Client & Revenue (/client-revenue) as SuperAdmin. Backend: 20/20 pytest pass (added a client workflow class and a retention release regression test). Frontend: the bottom action bar works on all 9 tabs. Buttons enable/disable correctly in each state (New, Save→View, Edit→editable, Submit, Final Approval, Delete), and Excel download and Print popup work on every tab. Client Registration works (IFSC auto-fill via razorpay, TMP-CL temp ID, Checked By required to Submit, step 3 sets permanent CL/000N code, approval banner, data sheet Load). Leads: Send Quotation and Mark Won → Client, which creates a step-1 temp client. Contract title is 'New Contract / Work Order' with a single TDS % (194C) field. MB, RA and CO workflows work. RA totals are correct: basic 5000, GST 900, retention 250, TDS 100, GST Payable 900, net 5550. No 'GST TDS' text anywhere. Milestones Complete & Bill creates a draft bill. Dashboard kpi-tds, kpi-gst-payable and the dash-tax-table columns are correct. Found and fixed 1 critical backend bug (retention release returned 500) and 3 minor frontend bugs.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent. It always returned 500 'TypeError: async_generator object is not iterable' because the code used sum(x async for ...) (server.py ~line 1070). Changed it to sum([... async for ...]). Retention release through the UI bottom bar now records, and the over-balance check gives 400. Regression test added.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED. The status span testid `${name}-status` clashed with client-status (Clients input) and lead-status (Leads select). Renamed it to `${name}-bar-status`.
FIXED. CRM_STATUS had no 'clients' entry, so the Status column showed '—' and the KPI counted approved clients as 'Pending'. Added clients: ['step', STEP_WF].
FIXED. Clients with only a temp ID showed as ' · Name' with no code. It now falls back to tempRefId.

issues: The bottom action bar wraps to 3 rows (128px). With the sticky global top nav (~210px), only ~500px of the 844px viewport is left for content. Consider compact icon-only buttons or a horizontally scrollable single row on mobile. There is no horizontal overflow, and the content is not covered (page bottom padding is OK).
The status span's marginLeft:auto pushes all buttons to the left, although justifyContent is center. This is cosmetic.

action_items: Review the retention_releases fix in server.py (sum over a list comprehension) and keep it.
Optional: reduce the mobile action bar height.
Optional consistency: on RA bills, Edit stays enabled at step 2 (Submitted) but MB/CO lock at step 2. Decide whether submitted RA bills should be editable.
Optional: the client Delete button is still enabled after step 3 approval (permanent code issued). Consider blocking deletion of approved clients.
Optional: Milestones bar approve calls setF(blank) even if the user cancels the confirm dialog. Leads/Clients/CO call crmNextNo before save, so a failed save burns a serial number.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py crm_upsert retention branch: the async-generator-inside-sum() bug is fixed. Look for the same pattern elsewhere.

Before testing there was an orphan RA bill (RA/CT/0001/02, Milestone, step 5) whose contract had been deleted. It inflated the dashboard KPIs and duplicated bill numbers after counters were reset. Cleanup must delete crm_ra_bills too (done this time). Consider blocking contract deletion while bills exist.
Backend clients workflow guard is verified: a non-approver gets 403 on step 3, and the server sets approvedByName itself (a client-supplied value is ignored).

success_rate.backend: 100% (20/20 after fix; retention release was failing before)
success_rate.frontend: ~96% (all flows pass after the 3 minor fixes)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_crm_revenue.py -n 0 -k 'not parse_sample'` (pytest.ini adds xdist; the env var must be exported). The bar status testid is now `<name>-bar-status`. UI flow order: Clients → Leads → Contracts → MB (manual qty) → RA (Generate from approved MB) → CO → Milestones → Retention. The WO AI parse was not called this iteration.
rca of the issue: Retention release 500: Python's sum() cannot consume an async generator expression `(x async for ...)`, so it raised TypeError on every POST. Reproduced via the UI ret-btn-save (no record saved, 500 in backend.out.log, traceback in backend.err.log line ~1033). Fixed by materialising the values with a list comprehension `[x async for ...]`.
